semantics.precision_scope: Exact state-published polygon of constituent parcel 461107326005000058 at 360 E Boyd Boulevard, bound to Microsoft LPO campus by the government-hosted application and embedded county record. The application reports 215.361 acres for this parcel; Microsoft describes approximately 500 acres for the initial campus. This is not the whole campus boundary, a specific LPO building, the current grading area or the proposed eastern expansion. No campus count is inferred from buildings or phases.
